audit_items.proof_trace: The ADL liquidation_incentive is intentionally non-zero: liquidation_calculate_seize_ctokens computes seized_value = repay_amount * (1 + liquidation_incentive) * price_ratio, so seized_value > bad_debt_covered whenever incentive > 0. The code comment explicitly states 'adl liquidation_incentive should not have exceeded non-adl liquidation_incentive', confirming the design allows a non-zero incentive bounded by the normal collateral liquidation_incentive. This is the standard DeFi liquidation bonus model applied to authorized ADL operators, not a security gap.
